scope: Original Android 15 core framework-connectivity JNI (NetworkUtils); libframework-connectivity-jni.so
notes: TcpRepairWindow is renamed to android.net.connectivity.android.net.TcpRepairWindow by the
jarjar step that builds this JNI's Java side into the Connectivity APEX, so the pinned
source hardcodes the relocated name in both FindClass and the JNI registration table.
Our framework is the un-jarjar'd monolithic build and declares NetworkUtils.getTcpRepairWindow
as returning android.net.TcpRepairWindow, so RegisterNatives rejected the whole table with
NoSuchMethodError and NetworkUtils.<clinit> aborted the process. Undoing the APEX rename
targets the build configuration we actually use; every other entry in the table already matched.
